title: Hunts FH-031T: Let the author pick the finale Event, and gate the completion reward on a seat

source.ref: Split from FH-031S (2026-11-18): the player's finale panel shipped dark; the author, reward and Event stop halves move here.

detail:
Owed after FH-031S. (1) Web: the author picks the host Event in the Trail editor, limited to Events of the Hunt's own Space or a live partner, and publish writes it to hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id (lib/hunts/draft.ts publish policy), checked again on the server at publish. (2) Game systems: the first route that grants a completion reward calls grantFinaleReward, and hunt_reward_grant gets the same seat check in SQL so the rule does not rest on one caller (a migration through the serialized gate). (3) An Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door. (4) A producer that queues the finale notice in the Hunt outbox with finaleBroadcastAggregate(eventId) (lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts), which route health already counts (FH-032S, 2026-11-18). (5) Operator: on a preview deployment, a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Done when: a creator can publish a Trail with a finale without touching JSON, and a completion reward is never granted to a player the host Event does not admit. Requires: FH-031S. Owner role: Web, with Game systems. Hunts switches stay OFF.

2026-11-23: closed by its probe. Built (1): the author picks the host Event on the editor's publish step (components/hunts/finale-event-field.tsx, the finaleEventId field of HUNT_MANIFEST), offered only upcoming Events of the Hunt's own Space or a live partner (lib/hunts/finale-store.ts loadFinaleEventOptions, the rule in lib/hunts/finale-draft.ts finaleEventAllowed). Publish writes hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id and asks the rule again with rows read now (finaleBlocksPublish in publishTrail), so a cancelled Event or a withdrawn partner blocks. Built the app half of (2): POST /api/hunts/rewards/grant, dark behind HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED, grants through grantRunReward, which sends a completion reward on a Trail with a finale through grantFinaleReward, so a finished player with no seat is refused before the database is called. Tests: lib/hunts/finale-store.test.ts, app/api/hunts/rewards/grant/route.test.ts. No SQL in this change. Not done and still owed, filed as FH-031U: the same seat check inside hunt_reward_grant (a migration), (3) the Event stop's door credit, (4) the finale notice producer, (5) the preview acceptance run. Nothing on a screen calls the grant route yet. Switches stay OFF.
